units.source_text: 听完匪徒这话，妻子竟然心驰荡漾的抬起脸来。

en.t: After hearing the bandit's words, my wife actually lifted her face with her heart stirring.

units.source_text: 我从没见过妻子这样美丽的时刻。

en.t: I had never seen my wife look so beautiful before.

units.source_text: 但是我美丽的妻子，当着被绑起来的丈夫的面，怎么能够回答匪徒的呢？

en.t: But how could my beautiful wife answer the bandit in front of her husband, who was tied up?

units.source_text: 虽然我已经死了，但是一想到妻子的话，我就怒火中烧。

en.t: Though I am already dead, the thought of my wife's words still makes me burn with rage.

units.source_text: 她竟然说：“好，带我到哪里都行吧。”

en.t: She actually said, "All right, take me anywhere you like."
